inlines.v: LORD'LY, adjective [lord and like.] 1. Becoming a lord; pertaining to a lord. Lordly sins require lordly estates to support them. 2. Proud; haughty; imperious; insolent. Every rich and lordly swain, with pride would drag about her chain. LORD'LY, adverb Proudly; imperiously; despotically. A famished lion, issuing from the wood, roars lordly fierce.
